abstract: The Office of the United States Trade Representative is providing notice of allocations of the Fiscal Year (FY) 2026 (October 1, 2025 through September 30, 2026) in-quota quantity of the tariff- rate quotas (TRQs) for imported raw cane sugar, certain sugars, syrups and molasses (also known as refined sugar), and sugar-containing products.

agencies.name: Trade Representative, Office of United States
agencies.raw_name: OFFICE OF THE UNITED STATES TRADE REPRESENTATIVE

dates: The changes made by this notice are applicable as of August 15, 2025.
title: Fiscal Year 2026 Tariff-Rate Quota Allocations for Raw Cane Sugar, Refined and Specialty Sugar, and Sugar-Containing Products
